PPHE Hotel Group is an international hospitality company, bringing together a diverse portfolio of hotels, restaurants, bars, and event destinations across Europe. From iconic city hotels to creative lifestyle concepts, we create valuable memories for our guests and stakeholders through individuality, passion, and collaboration.

As a Brand Content Marketing Intern, you support the delivery of engaging and on-brand content across multiple platforms, contributing to brand visibility and guest engagement. Working closely with the marketing team, you gain hands-on experience in content creation, digital marketing, and campaign execution while supporting both strategic projects and day-to-day operations.

This internship is available from September 2026 and offers a full-time learning experience for a minimum of 6 months, aligned with your study requirements.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate and implement content updates on content management systems

• Support the creation and planning of social media calendars and posts

• Create engaging website and digital content aligned with brand guidelines

• Conduct competitor research and support trend analysis

• Upload blog articles and assist with content publishing

• Monitor and update imagery in line with seasonal campaigns

• Design and create social media assets using Canva or Photoshop

• Support the creation of landing pages for brand-led initiatives

• Contribute to campaign planning, brainstorming sessions, and activations

• Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure content needs are met

• Support the wider marketing team with ad hoc requests

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree programme, preferably in marketing, hospitality, or a related field

• Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken

• Proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively

• Creative mindset with strong attention to detail
